verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation product with its own Dashboard, so in-product AI insights are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes only show documentation published for LLMs, which is not an in-product AI capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
